en.title: US PUC Addresses Disability Accessibility Concerns Amid Funding and Tech Updates
en.summary: The Public Utilities Commission responded to accessibility concerns for people with disabilities, outlining steps to improve service access. Meanwhile, the Beckley region secured $637K for sidewalk, pedestrian bridge, and park accessibility projects, and a city launched robot-assisted sidewalk assessments to advance ADA compliance. Additionally, Luxury Bath Technologies promoted accessible walk-in bathtubs with secure seating and grab bars.

highlights.title: Public Utilities Commission responds to accessibility concerns
Beckley region receives $637K for sidewalks, pedestrian bridge and park accessibility projects
City launches robot-assisted sidewalk assessment to advance Vision Zero and ADA accessibility planning
The Guardian view on disability benefits: Pip must not become another route for cuts
Luxury Bath Technologies Promotes Accessible Walk-In Bathtubs

zh-TW.title: 美國PUC回應無障礙關切，貝克利獲資金改善人行道及機器人評估
zh-TW.summary: 美國公共事業委員會回應殘疾人士無障礙服務的關切，並概述改善措施。貝克利地區獲得637,000美元用於人行道、行人橋及公園無障礙工程，同時城市啟動機器人輔助人行道評估以推進ADA合規。此外，社群討論強調無香氛環境對殘障人士的重要性。

highlights.title: 公共事業委員會回應無障礙問題
衛報評論：殘障福利不應成為削減的另一條途徑
貝克利地區獲得637,000美元用於人行道、行人橋及公園無障礙工程
城市啟動機器人輔助人行道評估，以推進 Vision Zero 和 ADA 無障礙規劃
